title: ID0395442-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P8 170001009] Hard-to-Open Door Lock
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
The door locking system is very hard to open. The gray part where you insert the key is hard to detach. You have to tap on it to raise it and thus free it from the hook that holds it in place. It took me a good 5 minutes to succeed in opening the door.
Open Ticket:
Yes
Root cause:
Solution:
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
No
Warranty Status:
Inactive (8/7/2024)

Hello RC-FR Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
ENGIE (France)
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / P8 170001009
Charger ID/Serial No.:
nHEhZ0
Problem Description:
Hard-to-Open Door Lock
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since
7th August 2024 (Factory) and 8th November 2024 (RC to customer),
as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
The customer has created a ticket reporting that the door locking system is difficult to open, with the gray part where the key is inserted being hard to detach.
Upon checking the charger details on ISP, we found an open case (0395440) for this unit, currently in the RC-FR Queue, regarding a black screen issue. We recommend addressing this issue as well while investigating the black screen problem.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
